positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Led engineering effort as team lead to improve identifying concurrent events within a network in order to generate clean groups of sites / customers.
•	Led multi-team roadmap development for a suite of products to enable analytically rigorous insights across campaigns as part of a Product Management allocation.
•	Specialized in enhancing functionality to support customer analytics through new visualizations and flexible dashboards.
•	Oversaw the onboarding and mentorship of  3 Associate Product Managers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed platform to analyze sales data and provide untapped insights for top retailers, restaurants, CPGs, and other verticals across the world.
• Contributed to ground-up overhaul of the core workflow, including developing a deep understanding of business use cases and areas of opportunity.
• Mentored and onboarded numerous interns, campus hires, and lateral hire engineers.
• Managed ongoing development of multiple Idea Marketplace projects.
• Planned and led multiple on-campus recruiting and outreach events.

positions.title: Founder, Member
positions.description:
• Managed a turn-key embedded systems project for controlling a new family of Dante-based commercial audio products.
• Responsible for recruiting two hardware engineers.
• Planned and chaired weekly product development meetings with clients.

positions.title: Course Assistant - Fundamentals of Programming (15-112)
positions.description:
• Assisted Professor David Kosbie in pioneering a new, rigorous and technical course.
• Directly responsible for aiding over 30 students each semester.
• Responsibilities included teaching a weekly recitation, holding regular office hours, effectively communicating with students, preparing staff for new material, and providing constructive feedback on students’ work.
* CA during F11, S12, S13, S14 semesters.

positions.title: Independent Contractor
positions.description:
• Designed and developed software to streamline production of Cirrus Logic’s CobraNet-based commercial audio products.
• Allowed for just in time variable product production as a replacement for the old system’s single batch process.
• Reduced programming portion of manufacturing time from over 2 minutes to a few seconds per unit and eliminated recurring pre-production set-up costs.

positions.title: Telefund Representative
positions.description: • Developed and strengthened Alumni relationships by personally acquainting alumni with university news, events, and community activities.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Business Admin., conc. in Finance and add'l minors in Computer Science and Software Engineering

honors.description: * Awarded for the 1st place project APKey-only, an excel-like keyboard shortcut add-on for any page in the APT platform.
